title: Spynixx Launcher v1.2.5 Release
content: Spynixx Launcher v1.2.5 is now available.
Integrated native in-app auto-updater engine for upcoming seamless updates.
Added manual Check for Updates button under Settings > About Spynixx Launcher.
Improved server ping stability, query timeouts, and retry backoff.
Optimized UI responsiveness, memory footprint, and notice delivery.
